annotation.title_en: National AI Program (Israel) – Situation Report and Strategic Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Israel Innovation Authority; National AI Program Directorate (Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, and others)
annotation.summary_en: Israel's multi-year (2021–2026) National AI Program, with about NIS 1 billion budgeted. It sets a strategy on AI research and compute infrastructure, industry adoption through regulatory sandboxes, public-sector AI adoption, geo-technological positioning, and national readiness. It excludes defense aspects and has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five goals: AI infrastructure and research, industry adoption, public-sector adoption, global geo-technological standing, national-level readiness.
Regulatory sandboxes and a cross-government regulatory knowledge hub and regulators' forum.
Domain data assets and virtual research rooms with anonymisation under the Privacy Protection Law.
Plan to publish AI regulation and ethics policy principles and create an expert advisory group.
Defense-related AI preparedness is explicitly outside the document's scope.
